info.name: BusLink API
info.description: Sprint 2 — passenger auth (register/login/refresh) and profile/QR endpoints. Sprint 3 — conductor auth, route/stop/fare APIs. Import into Postman Desktop. Run Auth > Login at least once to populate {{accessToken}} before hitting User; run Conductor Auth > Login at least once to populate {{conductorAccessToken}} and {{routeId}} before hitting Route/Fare. Sprint 4 — ticket issuance and wallet payment APIs. Run Conductor Auth > Login and User > QR Token at least once to populate {{routeId}}, {{busId}}, and {{qrToken}} before hitting Ticket/Payment. Sprint 5 — Razorpay wallet recharge and UPI ticket payment initiation (Payment > Initiate Recharge / Initiate Ticket UPI Payment). These only start the payment — completing checkout and confirming the resulting webhook happens outside Postman (browser checkout + ngrok); see docs/sprints/Sprint-05.md's S5-21 for the full guided flow.
